title: 第二十一 章 遇袭第 二十二章 到达目的地
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
除了负责值守的人员，其他人都在打坐恢复灵力的状态中，四周一片寂静，无人言语。
夜深时分，微风轻拂，树叶沙沙作响。
夏玄洲守在夏临渊身旁，不仅为其护法，还时刻警惕地监视着周围的一举一动。
突然，一阵狂风呼啸而至，周围的树木被吹得剧烈摇晃。
沙沙沙……
不远处，传来沙石相互摩擦的细微声响，在这寂静的夜里显得格外突兀。
夏临渊瞬间睁开双眼，眉头紧紧皱起，神色凝重。
“玄洲，你可察觉到什么异样？”
夏玄洲轻轻摇了摇头，说道：“大哥，不过是石头和树叶的混合声响，没什么可疑之处，我一直留意着呢！”
听到弟弟如此说，夏临渊扫视了一圈，这才稍稍放下心来。
“难道真是我多心了？”
夏临渊低声嘀咕一句，随后又缓缓闭上眼睛，继续休整。
然而，没过多久，那沙沙声竟愈发清晰，愈发靠近。
夏临渊猛地再次睁开双眼，心中涌起一股强烈的不安。
“大家注意，有情况！”夏临渊对着正在打坐的众人大声吼道。
“啊啊啊……”
他的话音刚落，几声凄厉的惨叫瞬间划破夜空。
众人被这突如其来的惨叫惊醒，纷纷迅速拿出各自的法器，警惕地注视着周围。
只见他们四周，突然冒出无数巴掌大小的蝎子，将他们团团围住。
这些蝎子通体呈暗褐色，与土壤颜色极为相近，完美地融入了周围环境，若非仔细观察，很难发现它们的踪迹。

夏临渊看清蝎子的特征后，脸色一变，立刻喊道：“这是隐尘蝎！”
他着实没想到会在此处遭遇这种难缠的妖兽。
这种隐尘蝎具有典型的群居习性，向来集体行动。
它们会先利用毒刺发动远程攻击，若猎物企图逃跑，便会迅速施展土遁术，追至猎物脚下，从地下冷不丁地伸出尾刺发动突袭，让人防不胜防。
而且，只要不靠近，几乎很难察觉到它们的存在，这正是隐尘蝎最为棘手的地方。
此刻，隐尘蝎已然开始用毒针对众人展开攻击。
无数细小如针的毒刺，如骤雨般射向众人。
前排的修士赶忙施展法术防御，一道道不同颜色的光幕瞬间在身前形成。
毒刺打在光幕上，发出乒乓的脆响。
然而，毒刺的数量实在太多，一道道光幕眨眼间便被无情打破。
光幕被破的修士急忙向后退去，后面的人迅速补上，这才勉强抵挡住蝎子的疯狂攻击。
与此同时，中间的修士纷纷打出数十道法术，朝着蝎子攻去。
眼见攻击就要命中，这些蝎子却瞬间施展土遁术，消失在地下，只在地面上留下几个巨大的深坑。
众人面面相觑，大气都不敢出，眼睛紧张地在四周来回搜寻着。
沙沙沙……
隐尘蝎在地下不停地游走，与地下的石头摩擦，发出连绵不绝的声响。
这让众人的心里很是紧张，不知道这些蝎子何时又会从地下钻出来。
突然，不远处传来两道尖锐的嘶喊声，两只体型巨大的蝎子赫然出现在众人眼前。
它们挥舞着两双粗壮有力的大钳子，气势汹汹地攻向众人。
content_en:
Except for the personnel on duty, everyone else was meditating to recover their spiritual power. The surroundings were silent and no one spoke.
Late at night, the breeze blows gently and the leaves rustle.
Xia Xuanzhou stayed by Xia Linyuan's side, not only protecting him, but also vigilantly monitoring every move around him.
Suddenly, a strong wind roared, and the surrounding trees were blown violently.
swish swish...
Not far away, there was a subtle sound of sand and stones rubbing against each other, which seemed particularly abrupt in the silent night.
Xia Linyuan opened his eyes instantly, his brows furrowed tightly, his expression solemn.
"Xuanzhou, do you notice anything strange?"
Xia Xuanzhou shook his head slightly and said, "Brother, it's just a mixture of stones and leaves. There's nothing suspicious about it. I've been paying attention!"
Hearing what his brother said, Xia Linyuan glanced around and felt a little relieved.
"Am I really too worried?"
Xia Linyuan murmured in a low voice, then slowly closed his eyes and continued to rest.
However, not long after, the rustling sound became clearer and closer.
Xia Linyuan suddenly opened his eyes again, feeling a strong uneasiness in his heart.
"Everyone, be careful, there's something going on!" Xia Linyuan shouted loudly to everyone who was meditating.
"Ahhhh..."
As soon as he finished speaking, several shrill screams instantly pierced the night sky.
Everyone was awakened by the sudden scream, and they quickly took out their magic weapons and watched the surroundings warily.
All around them, countless palm-sized scorpions suddenly appeared, surrounding them.
These scorpions are dark brown in color, very similar to the color of the soil, and blend in perfectly with the surrounding environment. It is difficult to spot them without careful observation.
After Xia Linyuan saw the characteristics of the scorpion, his expression changed and he immediately shouted: "This is the Hidden Dust Scorpion!"
He really didn't expect to encounter such a difficult monster here.
This kind of dust scorpion has a typical gregarious habit and always acts in groups.
They will first use their poisonous stingers to launch long-range attacks. If the prey attempts to escape, they will quickly use the earth escape technique to chase the prey to its feet, and suddenly extend its tail stingers from the ground to launch a surprise attack, making it difficult for people to guard against it.
Moreover, as long as you don't get close, it is almost difficult to detect their presence. This is the most troublesome thing about the Hidden Dust Scorpions.
At this moment, the Hidden Dust Scorpion had already begun to attack everyone with its poisonous needles.
Countless poisonous stings as small as needles were shot at everyone like a shower.
The monks in the front row quickly cast their magic defense, and light curtains of different colors formed in front of them instantly.
The stinger hit the light curtain and made a pinging sound.
However, there were too many stingers, and the light curtains were ruthlessly broken in the blink of an eye.
The monk whose light barrier was broken hurriedly retreated, and the people behind him quickly made up for it, and finally managed to withstand the scorpion's crazy attack.
At the same time, the monks in the middle fired dozens of spells and attacked the scorpion.
Seeing that the attack was about to hit, these scorpions instantly used the Earth Escape Technique and disappeared underground, leaving only a few huge deep pits on the ground.
Everyone looked at each other, not daring to express their anger, and their eyes searched around nervously.
swish swish...
The Hidden Dust Scorpion kept wandering underground, rubbing against the stones underground and making a continuous sound.
This made everyone very nervous, wondering when these scorpions would come out of the ground again.
Suddenly, two sharp screams came from not far away, and two huge scorpions suddenly appeared in front of everyone.
They wielded two pairs of thick and powerful pincers and attacked everyone menacingly.
